title: Land stranded hostcontext-1102 Windows host-context installation verification onto main
goal: Port the eight stranded hostcontext-1102 commits onto current main: reject production installation verified only inside a private Windows filesystem view, hand packaged callers off to a one-shot least-privilege Task Scheduler worker in the ordinary user session, preserve deep Windows paths during release health checks, trust the machine Windows directory, and keep the cross-OS source portable.
